name: sentinelone
title: SentinelOne
description: Pulls threats from the SentinelOne management API (/web/api/v2.1/threats) and maps them to Faraday hosts and vulnerabilities. Configure SENTINELONE_URL (console URL, no trailing slash) and SENTINELONE_TOKEN as agent env vars; optionally scope with SENTINELONE_ACCOUNT_ID. Per-scan, use SENTINELONE_SINCE (ISO date) to limit how far back to fetch.
